messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Help for copying colnames and rownames in MathExt.transpose()
parts:
See my comment on your commit...
The dimnames attributes takes the form list( c("row1", "row2"),
c("col1", "col2", "col3") )

Try this:

> m <- rbind(a=c(x=1,y=2,z=3),b=c(1,2,3))
> m
x y z
a 1 2 3
b 1 2 3
> dimnames(m)
[[1]]
[1] "a" "b"

[[2]]
[1] "x" "y" "z"
